approach: Staged, because the whole migration at once cannot be verified without a full local suite but each stage can. (1) custody supplement as its own dated file plus a frozen_check flag to read it, with its own controls; (2) selector migration onto the PR #31 manifest resolver and regeneration of the 88 outputs; (3) the 15 lane D routes; (4) file the held H3 record unchanged. Each stage is small enough that targeted tests and all 17 checkers are real coverage, and CI verifies it before the next begins. Supplement is a separate dated file, never appended to drive/inventory.jsonl, whose provenance is 4,456 of the 4,456 rows of a Files.csv that is byte-identical to the live Drive object. Ten of eleven custody hashes still unverified by me; the eleventh reproduced exactly.
